відповідь.body: {"content":[{"type":"text","text":"{\"version\":\"1\",\"text\":\"The cherry heels and the deep burgundy bag stay in the same red family as the dress, and the shiny gold earrings add one small glint. That keeps the look in one colour story. It works because the red dress is the bold statement you asked for, and the quieter shades around it let it lead. Red is a festive colour for a ceremony at four in the afternoon, and it stays clear of the white that belongs to the bride. The fitted cut draws one clean line from shoulders to hem, and the heels lengthen your legs. Through the day the look moves easily from the outdoor ceremony to the restaurant. The earrings catch the daylight first and the warm restaurant light later.\",\"how_to_wear\":[\"Let the red dress be the only loud note: the cherry shoes and the burgundy bag are there to support it, so keep everything else quiet.\",\"Treat the gold earrings as the one point of shine, so they catch the light next to your face without competing with the dress.\",\"On grass or gravel at the outdoor ceremony, step on the balls of your feet in the cherry heels so they don't sink, and keep to firmer paths where you can.\"],\"wrong_photos\":[],\"named\":[{\"n\":\"#309·34\",\"what\":\"red fitted dress\"},{\"n\":\"#1·34\",\"what\":\"cherry heeled shoes\"},{\"n\":\"#151·40\",\"what\":\"burgundy bag\"},{\"n\":\"#105·34\",\"what\":\"golden earrings\"}],\"about_items\":[{\"n\":\"#309·34\",\"text\":\"A bodycon dress in a rich, saturated red that follows your figure in one smooth line. It is a confident, festive piece for a ceremony.\"},{\"n\":\"#1·34\",\"text\":\"Dress shoes with a heel, in a muted cherry red. They have a polished, formal look and add height and a longer leg line.\"},{\"n\":\"#151·40\",\"text\":\"A burgundy bag in a deep wine shade, with a simple, classic shape. Its dark tone anchors the brighter reds.\"},{\"n\":\"#105·34\",\"text\":\"Golden earrings with a shiny finish that catch the light.
